#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise current helper/compiler isolation with actual native flag consumption."""
import datetime
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

root, repo, helper = (Path(arg).resolve() for arg in sys.argv[1:4])
compiler = os.environ['MANTLE_EXECUTION_COMPILER']
oracle = '/nix/store/1hz41jg6cc3py3szsn6cxw3m5p42r4fj-rust-default-1.96.0-nightly-2026-04-08'
linker = '/nix/store/hb2bs5fg5wkm04x565737qd5nh2hy5nk-gcc-wrapper-15.2.0'
bwrap = '/nix/store/vvxfl9d1b9a944ca7miswhnxg06cs6jl-mantle-wasm-component-toolchain-v1/bin/bwrap'
pkg_config = Path(shutil.which('pkg-config')).resolve()
pkg_root = str(pkg_config.parent.parent)
assert pkg_root.startswith('/nix/store/') and pkg_config.parent.name == 'bin'
assert not root.exists(), 'fresh owned scratch root required'
root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
logs = root / 'commands'
logs.mkdir()
records = []
private_store = f'local?root={root}/private-nix'


def run(label, argv, env=None):
    argv = [str(arg) for arg in argv]
    item = {'label': label, 'argv': argv, 'started_at': datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()}
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=repo, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=180)
    item['exit_code'] = result.returncode
    for name in ['stdout', 'stderr']:
        path = logs / f'{label}.{name}'
        path.write_bytes(getattr(result, name))
        item[name] = str(path)
    records.append(item)
    (root / 'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2) + '\n')
    assert result.returncode == 0, f'{label}: inspect retained streams'
    return result.stdout.decode()


def put(path, text):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text)


def store(path, name):
    return run(f'add-{name}', ['nix', '--store', private_store, 'store', 'add-path', '--name', name, path]).strip()


source = root / 'stage/source'
native = root / 'stage/native'
put(source / 'answer.c', 'int boundary_answer(void) { return 42; }\n')
(native / 'lib').mkdir(parents=True)
run('compile-declared-C-input', [linker + '/bin/cc', '-c', source / 'answer.c', '-o', native / 'answer.o'])
run('archive-declared-C-input', ['ar', 'rcs', native / 'lib/libboundary_native.a', native / 'answer.o'])
put(native / 'lib/pkgconfig/boundary-native.pc', 'Name: boundary-native\nDescription: Explicit smoke input\nVersion: 1.0\nLibs: -lboundary_native\n')
native_path = store(native, 'cargo-boundary-native-input')
probe = r'''use std::{fs, path::Path, process::Command};
fn observe(command: &str) -> String {
    match Command::new(command).arg("--version").output() {
        Ok(output) => format!("{{\"launched\":true,\"success\":{},\"exit_code\":{},\"stdout\":{:?},\"stderr\":{:?}}}",
            output.status.success(), output.status.code().unwrap_or(-1),
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout), String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)),
        Err(error) => format!("{{\"launched\":false,\"error\":{:?}}}", error.to_string()),
    }
}
fn main() {
    let cfg = Command::new(std::env::var("RUSTC").unwrap()).args(["--print", "cfg"]).output().unwrap();
    assert!(cfg.status.success());
    assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&cfg.stdout).contains("target_arch="));
    let pc = Command::new("pkg-config").args(["--modversion", "boundary-native"]).output().unwrap();
    assert!(pc.status.success(), "{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&pc.stderr));
    assert_eq!(pc.stdout, b"1.0\n");
    let absolute = "ABSOLUTE_CARGO";
    let text = format!("{{\"rustc_cfg\":true,\"pkg_config_version\":\"1.0\",\"path_cargo\":{},\"absolute_cargo\":{},\"absolute_exists\":{},\"host_hostname_visible\":{}}}",
        observe("cargo"), observe(absolute), Path::new(absolute).exists(), Path::new("/etc/hostname").exists());
    fs::write(Path::new(&std::env::var("OUT_DIR").unwrap()).join("cargo-observation.json"), text).unwrap();
    let native = std::env::var("NATIVE_ROOT").unwrap();
    println!("cargo:rustc-link-search=native={native}/lib");
    println!("cargo:rustc-link-lib=static=boundary_native");
}
'''.replace('ABSOLUTE_CARGO', oracle + '/bin/cargo')
put(source / 'build.rs', probe)
put(source / 'app.rs', 'unsafe extern "C" { fn boundary_answer() -> i32; }\nfn main() { let answer = unsafe { boundary_answer() }; assert_eq!(answer, 42); println!("no-cargo-native-answer={answer}"); }\n')
compiled = root / 'stage/compiled'
(compiled / 'lib').mkdir(parents=True)
run('compile-identical-probe', [compiler + '/bin/rustc', source / 'build.rs', '--edition=2024', '--crate-name=build_script_build', '-C', f'linker={linker}/bin/cc', '-o', compiled / 'lib/build_script_build'])
put(compiled / 'share/mantle/unit-dependencies-v1.json', json.dumps({'schema': 'mantle-unit-dependencies-v1', 'direct_dependencies': [], 'artifacts': ['lib/build_script_build']}))
outside = root / 'outside'
outside.mkdir()
outside_env = dict(os.environ, PATH=oracle + '/bin:' + str(pkg_config.parent), OUT_DIR=str(outside), RUSTC=compiler + '/bin/rustc', NATIVE_ROOT=native_path, PKG_CONFIG_PATH=str(root / 'private-nix' / native_path.lstrip('/') / 'lib/pkgconfig'))
run('same-script-outside-positive', [compiled / 'lib/build_script_build'], outside_env)
control = json.loads((outside / 'cargo-observation.json').read_text())
assert control['path_cargo']['success'] and control['absolute_cargo']['success'] and control['host_hostname_visible'], control
facts = root / 'stage/facts'
run('current-helper-target-facts', [helper, 'target-facts'], dict(os.environ, out=str(facts), MANTLE_UNIT_RUSTC=compiler + '/bin/rustc', MANTLE_UNIT_HOST='x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu', MANTLE_UNIT_TARGET='x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu'))
runtime = sorted(set(re.findall(r'/nix/store/[^/\s]+', run('current-helper-runtime', ['ldd', helper]))))
closure = json.loads(run('execution-closure', ['nix', 'path-info', '--recursive', '--json', compiler, linker, pkg_root, *runtime]))
closure_paths = sorted(closure) if isinstance(closure, dict) else sorted(item['path'] for item in closure)
assert oracle not in closure_paths
assert not any((Path(path) / 'bin/cargo').exists() for path in closure_paths), 'Cargo in admitted execution closure'
source_path = store(source, 'cargo-boundary-source')
compiled_path = store(compiled, 'cargo-boundary-compiled')
facts_path = store(facts, 'cargo-boundary-target-facts')
helper_path = store(helper, 'cargo-boundary-current-helper')
private_inputs = [native_path, source_path, compiled_path, facts_path, helper_path]
work = root / 'sandbox-work'
work.mkdir()


def sandbox(environment, command):
    argv = [bwrap, '--die-with-parent', '--new-session', '--unshare-all', '--tmpfs', '/nix/store']
    for path in closure_paths:
        argv += ['--ro-bind', path, path]
    for path in private_inputs:
        argv += ['--ro-bind', root / 'private-nix' / path.lstrip('/'), path]
    argv += ['--proc', '/proc', '--dev', '/dev', '--tmpfs', '/tmp', '--bind', work, '/build', '--chdir', '/build', '--clearenv']
    for key, value in environment.items():
        argv += ['--setenv', key, value]
    return argv + ['--', *command]


script_env = {'RUSTC': compiler + '/bin/rustc', 'NATIVE_ROOT': native_path, 'PKG_CONFIG_PATH': native_path + '/lib/pkgconfig'}
run_env = {
    'out': '/build/script-out', 'flags': '/build/script-flags',
    'MANTLE_UNIT_SOURCE': source_path, 'MANTLE_UNIT_BUILD_SCRIPT': compiled_path,
    'MANTLE_UNIT_TARGET_FACTS': facts_path, 'MANTLE_UNIT_RUSTC': compiler + '/bin/rustc',
    'MANTLE_UNIT_SCRIPT_ENV': json.dumps(script_env), 'MANTLE_UNIT_SCRIPT_PATH': json.dumps([str(pkg_config.parent)]),
    'MANTLE_UNIT_NATIVE_INPUTS': json.dumps([native_path, pkg_root]), 'MANTLE_UNIT_LINKS_DEPENDENCIES': '[]',
}
run('current-helper-actual-bwrap-script', sandbox(run_env, [helper_path, 'run-build-script']))
inside = json.loads((work / 'script-out/cargo-observation.json').read_text())
assert inside['rustc_cfg'] and inside['pkg_config_version'] == '1.0'
assert inside['path_cargo'].get('launched') is False and inside['absolute_cargo'].get('launched') is False, inside
assert not inside['absolute_exists'] and not inside['host_hostname_visible'], inside
out_path = store(work / 'script-out', 'cargo-boundary-script-out')
flags_path = store(work / 'script-flags', 'cargo-boundary-script-flags')
private_inputs += [out_path, flags_path]
compile_env = {
    'out': '/build/consumer', 'MANTLE_UNIT_SOURCE': source_path,
    'MANTLE_UNIT_RUSTC': compiler + '/bin/rustc', 'MANTLE_UNIT_LINKER': linker + '/bin/cc',
    'MANTLE_UNIT_DEPENDENCIES': '[]', 'MANTLE_UNIT_EXTERNS': '{}', 'MANTLE_UNIT_COMPILE_ENV': '{}',
    'MANTLE_UNIT_BUILD_SCRIPT_OUT': out_path, 'MANTLE_UNIT_BUILD_SCRIPT_FLAGS': flags_path,
    'MANTLE_UNIT_TARGET_KIND': 'bin', 'MANTLE_UNIT_TARGET_NAME': 'boundary_consumer',
}
run('current-helper-native-consumer-compile', sandbox(compile_env, [helper_path, '--crate-name=boundary_consumer', '--crate-type=bin', '--edition=2024', source_path + '/app.rs']))
consumer = run('actual-native-consumer-execution', sandbox({}, ['/build/consumer/lib/boundary_consumer']))
assert consumer == 'no-cargo-native-answer=42\n', consumer
receipt = {
    'schema': 'mantle-cargo-denial-native-runtime-v1',
    'outside_same_executable': control, 'inside_current_helper_bwrap': inside, 'native_consumer_stdout': consumer,
    'compiler': compiler, 'helper': str(helper), 'pkg_config': str(pkg_config),
    'execution_closure': closure_paths, 'private_inputs': private_inputs,
    'script_environment': run_env, 'consumer_environment': compile_env, 'commands': records,
    'non_claims': [
        'Actual current-helper bwrap execution and native flag consumption; not a completed signed Mantle pipeline or full dynamic producer/application replay.',
        'Native archive is an explicit precompiled smoke input, not native C compilation inside build.rs or a Mantle-built provider/selective-rerun campaign.',
        'No frozen G1/G2 admission, source approval, spec synchronization, lifecycle acceptance, archive or release.'
    ]
}
(root / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Cargo PATH/absolute denied; rustc cfg/pkg-config/native consumer PASS', flush=True)
